title: Suspicious management surface probing associated with UNC3886 - BROAD
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects suspicious external access to network appliance or virtualization management surfaces associated with UNC3886-style probing. Variant 1 fires on appliance-specific URIs (VMware, Juniper, FortiGate, Cisco) regardless of user agent. Variant 2 fires on generic admin URIs when an automation user agent is present.
